name: heavypad disk telemetry missing
description: No disk sample from HeavyPad in five minutes. A missing or stopped sampler is unknown disk coverage, not healthy storage.
query: SELECT 'HeavyPad disk telemetry missing for five minutes; check bandwidth-watchdog and host availability' AS message WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM records WHERE service_name = 'bandwidth-watchdog' AND attributes->>'watchdog_event' = 'disk.sample' AND attributes->>'host' = 'heavypad' AND start_timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes')
